instructions: A standard-library-only Python MCP server that measures pages with Google PageSpeed Insights. Reviews cost a credit from a 30-a-month budget, so spend the comments on correctness, security and broken contracts rather than taste. The organisation-level custom context carries the standing rules for this repo: the Python 3.9 floor, the standard-library constraint, the generated manifest, and the no-number-without-its-uncertainty rule. CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md are the source of truth for the ground rules and the release order.
